correctness.rationale: Reduction to the exact equation 2Q^3+(XYZ)^2 and its gradient classifies all ten geometric singular points. Transverse axis-conic intersections yield six A2 cusps; four sign points have nonsquare tangent discriminant 3 and hence nonsplit nodes. Bezout and the cubic arithmetic-genus bound establish geometric integrality; ten delta-one defects give a genus-zero rational normalization. The normalization local-units exact sequence gives the F5-group and all-extension arithmetic. Finite GF5/GF25 point enumeration and exact discriminant calculations were executed successfully.

value.rationale: The precise arithmetic singularity basket, including the Galois action on node branches, determines the connected generalized Jacobian and singular-curve zeta function at a natural bad prime of a classical highly symmetric genus-six curve. This is materially more than the known genus-zero observation and is useful for comparing reductions and arithmetic degenerations; no stable-reduction claims are made.
